Durability
It’s not disposable. It’s family.
Life moves fast. Don’t slow it down with a car you can’t trust. At Subaru, we build each of our vehicles with the
highest standards of manufacturing, and with designs that are inherently tough and resilient. It’s why our vehicles
excel in the extreme rigors of rally racing. And why 95% of all vehicles sold in the last 10 years are still on the road
today.14 It’s also why Subaru owners are so likely to stay Subaru owners for years and years. What’s more, keeping
cars on the road means they stay out of landfills longer. And if we can make the world a cleaner and greener place
while making cars that inspire and motivate their drivers, we’ve done our job.
